calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_ids, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_all, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts, MAX(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)) AS maxd
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_with_test_line,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_store999,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.receipt_id IS NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_no_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id NOT IN (900,999) THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_other_store
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT 'helsinki_date' AS basis, COUNT(*) AS non_cancelled
FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'utc_date', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_groups, COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) AS extra_rows FROM (
  SELECT member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross, line_count, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

SELECT status, fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
